review.drawings: All26 current and27 noncover alternate whole plan sheets visually inspected. Thirteen unit drawings and thirteen floor keys from each edition retained separately, plus alternate ground/lower floor plate and three community sheets. All26 independent numerical panels visually read. Original plan notices, unit counts, logos and duplex levels remain intact.
